Runs a nightly ledger backtest, sends Slack alerts, and reports mismatch status.

# Purpose
This Bash script runs a Firedancer ledger backtest for a selected ledger snapshot and reports the result to Slack. It parses command-line options for the ledger name, snapshot, end slot, funk page count, index limit, trash hash, and cluster version, then prepares shared memory pages if needed before starting the run. The script writes a backtest configuration file, runs `firedancer-dev configure init all` and `firedancer-dev backtest`, and checks the log for success or bank hash mismatch messages. It sends a start message and a final success or failure message to Slack, and it finishes by calling `firedancer-dev configure fini all` to clean up.
